node.statement: Deeper-row correction: for H={j:d_j>a*tau}, split H into indices with d_j<=d and d_j>d. Then sum_{j in H} a_j^+ d_j <= sigma_a(v)*d + sum_{j in H,d_j>d} a_j^+*(d_j-d) = sigma_a(v)*d + C_a(v). Combining this with the convexity step and moving sigma_a(v)*d to the left gives (1-sigma_a(v))*d <= C_a(v)+(1-sigma_a(v))*dist_1(q,C).
